title: Standards for Administrative Fines by Type of Violation (Re: Article 24)
full_text:
Standards for Administrative Fines by Type of Violation (Re: Article 24)
■ Enforcement Decree of Internet Multimedia Broadcast Services Act [Appendix 6] <Amended 2024. 7. 16.>

Standards for Administrative Fines by Type of Violation (Re: Article 24)

| Violation | Applicable provision of the Act | Administrative fine |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. Failing to file a report under the proviso of Article 11(1)1 of the Act | Article 28(1)1 of the Act | 5 million won |
| 1-2. Failing to submit data under Article 12(4) of the Act | Article 28(1)1-2 of the Act | 10 million won |
| 2. Conducting business providing Internet multimedia broadcast services without reporting or reporting changes to the terms and conditions of use, or without obtaining approval or approval for changes to those terms and conditions, in violation of Article 15(1) or (3) of the Act | Article 28(1)2 of the Act | |
| 1) Conducting business providing Internet multimedia broadcast services without reporting or reporting changes to the terms and conditions of use, in violation of Article 15(1) of the Act | | 5 million won |
| 2) Conducting business providing Internet multimedia broadcast services without obtaining approval or approval for changes to the terms and conditions of use, in violation of Article 15(3) of the Act | | 10 million won |
| 3. Failing to submit data in violation of Article 15(4) of the Act | Article 28(1)3 of the Act | 5 million won |
| 4. Failing to take measures to protect information on users under Article 16(2) of the Act | Article 28(1)4 of the Act | 10 million won |
| 4-2. Failing to submit necessary data without a special reason, in violation of Article 16-2(2) of the Act | Article 28(1)4-2 of the Act | 3 million won |
| 5. Failing to file a report under Article 22 of the Act | Article 28(1)5 of the Act | 5 million won |
| 6. Failing to comply with a corrective order or similar measure under Article 26 of the Act | Article 28(1)6 of the Act | 10 million won |
